points.description: States that the queue is implemented with a circular array (circular buffer), where the rear/tail pointer wraps around to the beginning of the array when it reaches the end (front toward the beginning, rear toward the end).
points.partial_credit: Half or more: says front/rear indices in an array but without wrap-around or circular idea, or says circular without explaining wrapping.

points.description: Mentions that the front is kept toward the beginning of the array and the rear toward the end, with the rear pointer moving forward as items are added.
points.partial_credit: Half: only one of front or rear placement given.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating a circular array in which the rear pointer wraps around, in any wording; brief answers like "circular array with wrap-around" earn P1 fully. Part marks for a plain array with front and rear indices but no wrap-around, or a vague description of circularity. No marks for unrelated answers (e.g. linked list, stack) or wrong claims about how the array works.
